import json

records = [json.loads(l) for l in open('outputs/docred_full_s1.jsonl')]

# Entity F1: match on (text_normalized)
# Relation F1: match on (head_normalized, tail_normalized, relation_id)
# For relations, need to map relation names to IDs

constraints = json.load(open('data/docred/ontology_constraints_docred.json'))
rel_types = constraints['relation_types']
name_to_id = {}
for rid, rname in rel_types.items():
    name_to_id[rname.lower().strip()] = rid
    name_to_id[rid.lower()] = rid

def normalize(text):
    return text.strip().lower()

def get_rel_id(rel_name):
    key = rel_name.strip().lower()
    if key in name_to_id:
        return name_to_id[key]
    return None

# Compute F1
ent_tp = ent_fp = ent_fn = 0
rel_tp = rel_fp = rel_fn = 0
n_with_gold = 0
n_parsed = 0

for rec in records:
    parsed = rec.get('parsed_output')
    gold_ents = rec.get('gold_entities', [])
    gold_rels = rec.get('gold_relations', [])
    
    if not parsed:
        ent_fn += len(gold_ents)
        rel_fn += len(gold_rels)
        continue
    n_parsed += 1
    if gold_ents or gold_rels:
        n_with_gold += 1
    
    # Entity F1 (text match, type-agnostic)
    pred_ent_texts = set(normalize(e['text']) for e in parsed.get('entities', []))
    gold_ent_texts = set(normalize(e['text']) for e in gold_ents)
    ent_tp += len(pred_ent_texts & gold_ent_texts)
    ent_fp += len(pred_ent_texts - gold_ent_texts)
    ent_fn += len(gold_ent_texts - pred_ent_texts)
    
    # Relation F1 (head, tail, relation_id match)
    pred_rels_set = set()
    for r in parsed.get('relations', []):
        rid = get_rel_id(r.get('type', ''))
        if rid:
            pred_rels_set.add((normalize(r['head']), normalize(r['tail']), rid))
    
    gold_rels_set = set()
    for r in gold_rels:
        gold_rels_set.add((normalize(r['head']), normalize(r['tail']), r['type']))
    
    rel_tp += len(pred_rels_set & gold_rels_set)
    rel_fp += len(pred_rels_set - gold_rels_set)
    rel_fn += len(gold_rels_set - pred_rels_set)

# Compute metrics
def prf(tp, fp, fn):
    p = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
    r = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
    f1 = 2 * p * r / (p + r) if (p + r) > 0 else 0
    return p, r, f1

ep, er, ef1 = prf(ent_tp, ent_fp, ent_fn)
